The statement p4 also counts this amount in the 'Offices' row (nonmajor 28,605 = 1,100 + 27,505), which the extraction puts under Fees of Office at statement level, so the detail is inconsistent with it.

issues.on_page: Register of Deeds P & M 'Filing & Recording Fees' 14,948
issues.issue: Recording/register of deeds fees are category Fees of Office under the user's rule; detail_category is already 'fees of office', so category and detail_category disagree. (The statement's 'Licenses and Permits' row includes the amount, but the statement line itself is recorded as printed.)
Statement p4 counts this in the 'Offices' row (Fees of Office at statement level). It is probably a county attorney fee, so Fees of Office would fit.

The split uses the Inheritance Fund column of the same printed row, so it is defensible, but inheritance tax is inferred from the fund name (the p7 schedule only says 'Taxes'). receipts[1].original_label 'Taxes (Inheritance Fund column)' is not printed text. The fund columns of the Taxes row add to 15,171,537, not 15,171,538, so the computed remainder 14,374,590 is 1 more than the columns show (14,374,589).
